Status labels used in this document: VERIFIED (confirmed in the current source code or existing documents) · PROTOTYPE (works in the React/LocalStorage prototype with mock or simulated behaviour) · PROPOSED (recommended production design, not built) · PENDING CONFIRMATION (needs a client decision) · NOT IMPLEMENTED · NOT VERIFIED.

Purpose

Define how the Bellomassi platform will be tested — levels, types, environments, tools, entry / exit criteria and responsibilities.

Scope

Prototype verification (current) and production platform testing (PROPOSED). No production test execution has taken place.

Definitions

Other terms: see BM-GLO-001 (Project Glossary).

4. Environments and data

Test and staging environments as BM-INF-003 (Infrastructure, Network Architecture and Server Specification). Synthetic data only; no production personal data in test. Provider sandboxes for integrations. Fixed seed for repeatable automated runs.

5. Entry and exit criteria

Phase Entry Exit
System test Build deployed to test; smoke passed; test cases reviewed 100 % planned cases executed; no open Critical / High; Medium with agreed workaround
UAT System test exit met; UAT users trained; UAT data loaded All UAT cases executed; no open Critical / High; client sign-off (BM-QA-003 (User Acceptance Testing (UAT) Plan))
Release UAT signed; release checklist complete Go-live approval (BM-DEP-001 (Release Management Process))

6. Defects

Severity and priority definitions, workflow and template: BM-QA-004 (Defect Management Process and Bug Report Template).

7. Metrics

Execution progress (% executed / passed), defect counts by severity and status, defect density per module, requirements coverage (requirements with ≥ 1 passed test), automation coverage, reopened rate, UAT pass rate. Reporting: BM-QA-005 (Test Execution Report (Template)) and BM-QA-006 (Test Summary Report (Template) and Quality Metrics). No metrics exist yet.
